title: Login valid
acceptance: OWNER/ADMIN/ANALYST/CLIENT/VIEWER can authenticate in their tenant.

title: Invalid password
acceptance: Wrong password is rejected without session issuance.

title: Unknown tenant
acceptance: A valid user cannot authenticate against another organization.

title: MFA required
acceptance: MFA-enabled staging account is rejected without a code.

title: MFA valid
acceptance: Correct TOTP completes authentication.

title: Session tenant binding
acceptance: A session cannot be replayed across organizations.

title: Review isolation
acceptance: Tenant A cannot list Tenant B reviews.

title: Case isolation
acceptance: Tenant A cannot read Tenant B cases.

title: Evidence isolation
acceptance: Tenant A cannot read Tenant B evidence.

title: Decision isolation
acceptance: Tenant A cannot read Tenant B decisions.

title: Submission isolation
acceptance: Tenant A cannot read Tenant B submissions.

title: Audit isolation
acceptance: Tenant A cannot read Tenant B security/audit records.

title: Review inbox
acceptance: Reviews render with rating, text, source and date.

title: Review detail
acceptance: A review can be opened only inside its tenant.

title: Create case
acceptance: Authorized human can create a case from a review.

title: Invalid review
acceptance: Case creation rejects a review outside the tenant.

title: Idempotent case creation
acceptance: Repeated identical request does not create a duplicate.

title: Case persistence
acceptance: Case created from a persistent review survives process restart.

title: Case status
acceptance: Newly created case enters the analysis workflow, not submission.

title: Evidence upload
acceptance: Authorized analyst can attach evidence.

title: Evidence integrity
acceptance: Stored evidence hash is preserved.

title: Evidence verification
acceptance: Authorized analyst/admin can verify evidence.

title: Fact extraction
acceptance: Evidence facts are associated with the case.

title: Contradiction detection
acceptance: Contradictions are surfaced for human review.

title: Readiness checklist
acceptance: Missing required evidence blocks readiness.

title: Evidence tenant isolation
acceptance: Evidence lookup cannot cross tenants.

title: Decision creation
acceptance: Authorized role can create a human-review decision.

title: Freeze gate
acceptance: Freeze requires a decision.

title: Snapshot hash
acceptance: Freeze stores an immutable snapshot hash.

title: Approval gate
acceptance: Approval before freeze is rejected.

title: Human approval
acceptance: Explicit authorized human approval is required.

title: Snapshot integrity
acceptance: Modified dossier cannot be approved against an old snapshot.

title: Submission preparation
acceptance: Submit creates preparation state only after approval.

title: No external action
acceptance: Submission preparation never performs an external Google action.

title: OWNER
acceptance: Owner can manage organization roles.

title: ADMIN
acceptance: Admin can perform authorized case/evidence operations.

title: ANALYST
acceptance: Analyst can analyze and prepare but remains human-gated.

title: CLIENT
acceptance: Client cannot perform restricted decision/freeze/approval actions.

title: VIEWER
acceptance: Viewer is read-oriented and cannot mutate restricted workflow.

title: Owner protection
acceptance: Only Owner can assign/remove Owner privileges.

title: Audit trail
acceptance: Sensitive workflow transitions emit auditable events.

title: Idempotency conflict
acceptance: Reusing a key with another payload returns conflict.

title: Repeated submission
acceptance: Repeated preparation with same key returns the same submission.

title: Rollback
acceptance: Failed database transactions do not leave partial events.

title: Staging health
acceptance: /health and /ready expose the expected V6.40 contract.

title: Browser security
acceptance: Browser loads no external Google resources.

title: Browser UAT flow
acceptance: Login, dashboard, reviews and dossiers render without JS/page errors.
